c01.text: Waiting on your working holiday visa?

c02.text: Don't book that flight yet. Here's why.

c03.text: One. Average processing is expected to be around three months.

c04.text: Two. You must be in the right place when it's granted.

c05.text: Applied in Australia? Be in Australia.

c06.text: Applied from overseas? Be outside Australia.

c07.text: Three. Wait for the grant before booking flights,

c08.text: or locking in work or study plans.

c09.text: Send this to a mate who's waiting on their visa.
